scope: Leviticus 4–27 (809), Numbers 1–36 (1,287) and Deuteronomy 1–34 (959) authored comparison records; scoped recheck of 39 literary proposals, selected readings, numerical checks and output identity

findings.result: Flock rendering retains the broader option already explicit in 5:6; no global probaton replacement was made.
Paws is supported by the bounded LSJ animal sense citing this passage; literal hands is preserved in the close draft.
Unusual selected-Greek readings were preserved and questions recorded rather than harmonized.
Age ranges, amounts and the stated twenty-obol equivalence were compared to the Greek running text.

The four new candidates were rechecked against exact baseline and authored source comparisons: movement of the camp, selected 2,250, direct-address dost, and adversative But. No general replacement rule was applied.
Selected subgroup totals differ from stated chapter totals by 150 and 500 respectively. These source discrepancies remain explicit; the draft does not change Greek figures to balance arithmetic.
Census and offering arithmetic agrees with the manually compared figures. The repeated offering lists remain in full.
Selected clause placement, ordering, scout names and fuller readings are preserved with explicit unresolved syntax and name decisions.
Exact candidate records rechecked against authored source comparisons: sin in him, sprinkling upon the house, and singular serpent in the petition. No global replacement rule was applied.

Kiln remains an explicit provisional lexical proposal. The recorded LSJ entry includes the competing alcove sense; the consulted scholarly review challenges that sense. Cited papyri and other works were not independently read. This is not settled specialist consensus.

Exact candidates preserve the partitive with some and the selected singular continual offering. The close stage preserves the earlier partitive wording; the following plural their is retained in 29:6.

The census total, repeated festival offering quantities, declining calf sequence, spoil halves and warrior levies agree with the manually read figures. Derived congregation levies are labelled calculations and remain outside the translation.

Selected masculine sin-possessor, longer settlement condition, two itinerary legs, doubled mountain wording, two-thousand-cubit measure and final daughters’ order are preserved. Difficult syntax remains flagged.
Because of you preserves causation without suggesting benefit; fearsome makes the causing-fear sense explicit. Earlier wording is retained in the close drafts.

The eleven generic-livestock proposals were rechecked against their authored Greek comparisons. Specific bovine cattle remains at 7:13, 28:4,18 and the later occurrence in 28:51; no global replacement was used.

The children are the subjects of the selected accusative participles at 11:19. At 18:20 negation belongs to commanded, preserving absent authorization rather than an explicit prohibition. Exact baseline and candidates were rechecked.

Source-led local preposition proposals were checked in their contexts. The difficult outcry/sin connection at 24:15 remains unresolved; the adversarial function of the witness is contextual rather than inserted into en soi at 31:26.
Now and personal emphasis replace an unexpressed behold; both 23:7 objects remain governed by speaking; the selected or and then are restored. The weight/measure idiom remains open.
Selected Syria, visions, second tithe, fuller curse, chapter boundary, healing sins, cleansing hearts, hands and Moses as speaker are retained rather than harmonized.

All 93 units were compared, retaining the full song and blessings, plural burial agency, and selected closing descriptions. Questions include 32:5,27,36,43 and 33:3,7–8,12,16,24. Seventy authored lineations preserve normalized wording; 32:5 retains its compact dash-connected display to avoid changing its exact spacing.

limits: No independent reviewer, exhaustive token alignment, apparatus collation or human read-aloud stage is credited. Retention does not resolve the questions explicitly listed in the passage records.
